headline: Record profit and strong demand; guidance points higher
summary_short: TSMC's Q3 2026 revenue was NT$1,494.24B (+50.9% y/y, +17.6% q/q) and EPS NT$29.43 (US$4.60 per ADR unit), with a 66.4% gross margin.
summary_long: Net income rose 68.7% y/y and 8.0% q/q to NT$763.06B. Gross margin was 66.4%, operating margin 58.7% and net margin 51.1%. Two-nanometer shipments were 8% of wafer revenue, 3-nanometer 33% and 5-nanometer 28%; advanced technologies were 79%. For Q4 2026 TSMC guides revenue of US$52.3-$54.3B, gross margin of 65%-67% and operating margin of 56.5%-58.5%, assuming 31.8 NT dollars per US dollar. Third-quarter figures have not yet been approved by the Board.
confidence_notes: The shard sourceLink was a Yahoo fallback; the 6-K press release was found by one web search and read on sec.gov. Figures are in NT$ under TIFRS except where US$ is stated. Y/y EPS growth from the release; 3Q26 numbers are pre-Board approval. Gross and operating margin comparisons are not in the release table.

drivers.explanation: CFO cited strong demand for leading-edge process technologies, with 2-nanometer at 8% and 3-nanometer at 33% of wafer revenue.
Management expects Q4 to be supported by continued strong leading-edge demand and a steep 2-nanometer ramp-up.
